passages.text: “To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the angel of the church in Ephesus.
Jesus holds the seven stars in His right hand.
Jesus walks among the seven golden lampstands.
Jesus commands John to write these words to the angel of the church in Ephesus.
passages.original: Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ λυχνιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν

passages.text: I know your deeds, your labor, and your perseverance. I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil, and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the angel of the church in Ephesus.
Jesus holds the seven stars in His right hand.
Jesus walks among the seven golden lampstands.
Jesus says, “I know your deeds.
I know your hard work.
I know your perseverance.
You do not tolerate evil people.
You have tested those who claim to be apostles.
They are not true apostles.
You found them to be liars.”
passages.original: Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ τὸν κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς

passages.text: Without growing weary, you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Ephesus.
He holds the seven stars in His right hand.
He walks among the seven golden lampstands.
You have shown perseverance.
You have endured many things for My name.
You have not grown weary.
passages.original: καὶ ὑπομονὴν ἔχεις καὶ ἐβάστασας διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ οὐ κεκοπίακες

passages.text: But I have this against you: You have abandoned your first love.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Ephesus.
He knows their deeds, labor, and perseverance.
He knows they cannot tolerate evil people.
He knows they have tested those who claim to be apostles but are not.
He knows they have exposed false apostles as liars.
He knows they have endured for His name without growing weary.
But Jesus has something against them.
They have abandoned their first love.
passages.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην σου τὴν πρώτην ἀφῆκες

passages.text: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church.
Jesus tells the church to remember how far they have fallen.
Jesus commands the church to repent.
Jesus tells the church to do the deeds they did at first.
If the church does not repent, Jesus will come to them.
If the church does not repent, Jesus will remove their lampstand from its place.
passages.original: μνημόνευε οὖν πόθεν πέπτωκας καὶ μετανόησον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἔργα ποίησον εἰ δὲ μή ἔρχομαί σοι καὶ κινήσω τὴν λυχνίαν σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς

passages.text: But you have this to your credit: You hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
passages.sermon: You have this to your credit.\r\nYou hate the works of the Nicolaitans.\r\nI also hate the works of the Nicolaitans.
passages.original: Ἀλλὰ τοῦτο ἔχεις ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
passages.sermon:
The Spirit speaks to the churches.
Anyone who has ears should listen.
The one who overcomes will receive a reward.
I will give that person the right to eat from the tree of life.
This tree is in the Paradise of God.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ Παραδείσῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Smyrna.
Jesus is the First and the Last.
Jesus died.
Jesus returned to life.
Jesus gives this message to the angel of the church in Smyrna.
passages.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Σμύρνῃ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος ὃς ἐγένετο νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν

passages.text: I know your affliction and your poverty—though you are rich! And I am aware of the slander of those who falsely claim to be Jews, but are in fact a synagogue of Satan.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Smyrna.
Jesus knows their suffering.
Jesus knows their poverty.
Jesus says they are actually rich.
Jesus knows about people who slander them.
These people claim to be Jews.
They are not really Jews.
They belong to the synagogue of Satan.
passages.original: Οἶδά σου τὴν θλῖψιν καὶ τὴν πτωχείαν ἀλλὰ πλούσιος εἶ καὶ τὴν βλασφημίαν ἐκ τῶν λεγόντων Ἰουδαίους εἶναι ἑαυτούς καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν ἀλλὰ συναγωγὴ τοῦ Σατανᾶ

passages.text: Do not fear what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer tribulation for ten days. Be faithful even unto death, and I will give you the crown of life.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Smyrna.
Jesus is the First and the Last.
Jesus died and returned to life.
Jesus says, “Do not fear what you are about to suffer.”
The devil will throw some of you into prison.
This will test you.
You will have trouble for ten days.
Be faithful, even if you must die.
I will give you the crown of life.
passages.original: Μηδὲν φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις πάσχειν ἰδοὺ μέλλει βάλλειν ὁ διάβολος ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε καὶ ἕξετε θλῖψιν ἡμερῶν δέκα γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
passages.sermon:
Anyone who has ears should listen.
The Spirit speaks to the churches.
The Spirit gives a message to all churches.
Anyone who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death.
The second death cannot harm the one who overcomes.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Ὁ νικῶν οὐ μὴ ἀδικηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ δευτέρου

passages.text: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of the One who holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Pergamum.
Jesus holds a sharp, double-edged sword.
Jesus gives this message to the angel of the church in Pergamum.
These are the words of Jesus.
passages.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Περγάμῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὴν ῥομφαίαν τὴν δίστομον τὴν ὀξεῖαν

passages.text: I know where you live, where the throne of Satan sits. Yet you have held fast to My name and have not denied your faith in Me, even in the day when My faithful witness Antipas was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Pergamum.
Jesus knows where the people in this church live.
They live where Satan’s throne is.
These people hold firmly to Jesus’ name.
They do not deny their faith in Jesus.
They stayed faithful even when Antipas was killed among them.
Antipas was Jesus’ faithful witness.
Satan lives in that place.
passages.original: Οἶδα ποῦ κατοικεῖς ὅπου ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Σατανᾶ καὶ κρατεῖς τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὴν πίστιν μου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἀντιπᾶς ὁ μάρτυς μου ὁ πιστός μου ὃς ἀπεκτάνθη παρ’ ὑμῖν ὅπου ὁ Σατανᾶς κατοικεῖ

passages.text: But I have a few things against you, because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Pergamum.
Jesus holds the sharp, double-edged sword.
Jesus says, “I have a few things against you.”
Some people among you follow the teaching of Balaam.
Balaam taught Balak to lead the Israelites into sin.
Balak caused the Israelites to eat food offered to idols.
Balak caused the Israelites to commit sexual immorality.
passages.original: Ἀλλ’ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὀλίγα ὅτι ἔχεις ἐκεῖ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Βαλαάμ ὃς ἐδίδασκεν τῷ Βαλὰκ βαλεῖν σκάνδαλον ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα καὶ πορνεῦσαι

passages.text: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
passages.sermon: Some of you hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.\r\nYou do this in the same way as others who follow false teachings.
passages.original: οὕτως ἔχεις καὶ σὺ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν ὁμοίως

passages.text: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church.
He commands you to repent.
If you do not repent, I will come to you soon.
I will fight against those who do wrong.
I will use the sword of My mouth.
passages.original: μετανόησον οὖν εἰ δὲ μή ἔρχομαί σοι ταχύ καὶ πολεμήσω μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ στόματός μου

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
passages.sermon:
The Spirit speaks to the churches.
Anyone who can hear should listen.
The Spirit gives a message to all churches.
The one who overcomes will receive hidden manna from the Son of God.
The one who overcomes will also receive a white stone.
This stone will have a new name written on it.
Only the person who receives the stone will know this new name.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ τοῦ μάννα τοῦ κεκρυμμένου καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ ψῆφον λευκήν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ψῆφον ὄνομα καινὸν γεγραμμένον ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ ὁ λαμβάνων

passages.text: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
passages.sermon:
The Son of God speaks.
He has eyes like a blazing fire.
He has feet like polished bronze.
Write these words to the angel of the church in Thyatira.
passages.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Θυατείροις ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἔχων τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ὡς φλόγα πυρός καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ

passages.text: I know your deeds—your love, your faith, your service, your perseverance—and your latter deeds are greater than your first.
passages.sermon:
The Son of God speaks to the church in Thyatira.
He has eyes like blazing fire.
He has feet like polished bronze.
He says, “I know your deeds.”
I know your love.
I know your faith.
I know your service.
I know your perseverance.
Your recent deeds are greater than your first deeds.
passages.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου τὰ ἔσχατα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων

passages.text: But I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols.
passages.sermon:
The Son of God speaks.
He has eyes like blazing fire.
He has feet like polished bronze.
He says this to the church in Thyatira.
He says, “I have something against you.”
“You tolerate that woman Jezebel.”
“She calls herself a prophetess.”
“She teaches My servants.”
“She leads My servants astray.”
“She causes them to be sexually immoral.”
“She causes them to eat food sacrificed to idols.”
passages.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἀφεῖς τὴν γυναῖκα Ἰεζάβελ ἡ λέγουσα ἑαυτὴν προφῆτιν καὶ διδάσκει καὶ πλανᾷ τοὺς ἐμοὺς δούλους πορνεῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα

passages.text: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Thyatira.
He refers to a woman called Jezebel.
She calls herself a prophetess.
She teaches and misleads Jesus’ servants.
She leads them to sexual immorality.
She leads them to eat food sacrificed to idols.
Jesus says, “I have given her time to repent.”
She does not want to repent of her immorality.
passages.original: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ χρόνον ἵνα μετανοήσῃ καὶ οὐ θέλει μετανοῆσαι ἐκ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς

passages.text: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Thyatira.
He warns about the woman Jezebel.
She calls herself a prophetess.
She leads God's servants into sin.
Jesus says, "I will throw Jezebel onto a bed of sickness."
Those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly.
They will face great trouble.
This will happen unless they repent of Jezebel's deeds.
passages.original: Ἰδοὺ βάλλω αὐτὴν εἰς κλίνην καὶ τοὺς μοιχεύοντας μετ’ αὐτῆς εἰς θλῖψιν μεγάλην ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσωσιν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς

passages.text: Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Thyatira.
He warns about a woman who leads others into immorality.
He says, "I will kill her children with death."
All the churches will know this happened.
They will know I am the One who searches minds and hearts.
I will give each of you what your deeds deserve.
passages.original: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἀποκτενῶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ γνώσονται πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐραυνῶν νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν

passages.text: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan: I will place no further burden upon you.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the rest of the people in Thyatira.
These people do not follow the false teaching.
They have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan.
Jesus says to them, “I will not put any other burden on you.”
passages.original: Ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς λοιποῖς τοῖς ἐν Θυατείροις ὅσοι οὐκ ἔχουσιν τὴν διδαχὴν ταύτην οἵτινες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰ βαθέα τοῦ Σατανᾶ ὡς λέγουσιν οὐ βάλλω ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἄλλο βάρος

passages.text: Nevertheless, hold fast to what you have until I come.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the faithful in Thyatira.
You do not follow false teaching.
You have not learned the deep things of Satan.
Hold tightly to what you have.
Keep your faith and obedience.
Continue until I come.
passages.original: πλὴν ὃ ἔχετε κρατήσατε ἄχρι οὗ ἂν ἥξω

passages.text: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end, I will give authority over the nations.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the church in Thyatira.
He addresses those who do not follow false teaching.
He promises a reward to the faithful.
Whoever overcomes will receive this reward.
Whoever keeps Jesus’ works until the end will also receive it.
Jesus will give this person authority.
This authority will be over the nations.
passages.original: Καὶ ὁ νικῶν καὶ ὁ τηρῶν ἄχρι τέλους τὰ ἔργα μου δώσω αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν

passages.text: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery —just as I have received authority from My Father.
passages.sermon:
Jesus speaks to the churches.
Jesus holds the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars.
Jesus has received authority from His Father.
The one who overcomes will receive authority over the nations.
He will rule the nations with an iron scepter.
He will break them like clay pots.
passages.original: καὶ ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ ὡς τὰ σκεύη τὰ κεραμικὰ συντρίβεται ὡς κἀγὼ εἴληφα παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου

passages.text: And I will give him the morning star.
passages.sermon: Jesus speaks to the one who overcomes.\r\nJesus promises a reward.\r\nJesus will give this person the morning star.
passages.original: καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ τὸν ἀστέρα τὸν πρωϊνόν

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.
passages.sermon: The Spirit speaks to the churches.\r\nAnyone who has an ear should listen.\r\nEach person must hear what the Spirit says.
passages.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις
